scope: Character and story art library; asset registration only.
ordering: assets is ordered exactly as supplied, 01 through 10. Each entry remains a separate illustration.

preparation.dimensions: Original pixel dimensions and aspect ratios retained; no resizing, cropping, or upscaling.
preparation.composition: Complete original compositions preserved. No lettering, watermarks, borders, retouching, or generated art added.
preparation.sources: JPEG attachments copied byte for byte under the assigned descriptive names. originalFilename records the filename supplied in the user mapping; attachmentFilename records the locally delivered attachment name.
preparation.paths: source.path and runtime.path are stable repository-relative paths; runtime.url is the stable public path relative to the application base URL.

characters.name: Mega
characters.identityRule: Assets 01-05 are alternate emotional/pose and chain-presence variants of one character, never separate characters.
characters.futureSelectionGuidance: The stolen-chain incident may later determine the appropriate chain/no-chain variant. chainState describes the illustration only and does not set possession, incident outcomes, or runtime selection rules.

implementationBoundaries: Store assets and design metadata only; do not automatically assign portraits to existing interface components.
Do not change gameplay, The Chains incident logic, dialogue systems, menus, or UI functionality.
These illustrations are reserved for the next content-production phase; no new UI or gameplay GOAL is started.
